post.description:
Rerun a retained legacy run's scenarios.json with streaming and diff every scenario.

The job result lists streaming manifests plus per-scenario parity counts; diff GeoTIFFs
(1=legacy-only, 2=streaming-only flooding) and parity/report.json go under output_prefix.
Authentication is required only when the server has OAuth credentials configured. See GET /auth/config.

HandFimOutput.title: HandFimOutput
HandFimOutput.description: Metadata for a single generated scenario output.

HandFimParameters.title: HandFimParameters
HandFimParameters.description: The shared scenario JSON schema with worker-specific validation.

HUC.title: Huc
HUC.description: Hydrologic Unit Code identifying the primary watershed corresponding to the input data. Used to locate the necessary input HAND and rating curve datasets.

ReachID.title: Reachid
ReachID.description: NWM identifier for the river reach corresponding to the input data. Used to process HAND-FIM for the location of interest.

Streamflow.title: Streamflow
Streamflow.description: Streamflow value in cubic meters per second (cms) used as input for the HAND-FIM method. Determines the extent of flooding in the inundation mapping process.

Reach.title: Reach
Reach.description: A single streamflow estimate for a river reach within a watershed.

ScenarioID.title: Scenarioid
ScenarioID.description: Unique identifier for the flood inundation mapping scenario. Also used to define the output file naming.

Reaches.title: Reaches
Reaches.description: List of river reach streamflow entries belonging to this scenario.

Scenario.title: Scenario
Scenario.description:
A flood inundation mapping scenario.

Groups one or more reach/streamflow entries that are combined into a
single output GeoTIFF.

parity.title: Parity
parity.description: Legacy/streaming comparisons; present only for parity jobs.

StoredHandFimResult.title: StoredHandFimResult
StoredHandFimResult.description: Successful outputs and the destination persisted by the worker.

max_procs.title: Max Procs
max_procs.description: Max concurrent HAND-FIM processes; omit to use the worker's HAND_FIM_MAX_PROCS (default 1).

overwrite.title: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Replace existing S3 objects with matching output keys; by default, conflicting keys fail the job.

execution_mode.title: Execution Mode
execution_mode.description: legacy downloads whole HUCs and writes one COG per scenario. updatedlegacy uses the same workflow with NOAA v4.8.14.0 instead of the original pinned code. streaming range-reads a prepared cloud-optimized hydrofabric per reach and writes tiled COGs plus a manifest per scenario; it requires output_bucket and a single process. updatedstreaming is streaming with NOAA v4.8.14.0's own flood kernel, matching updatedlegacy.

ScenarioManifest.title: ScenarioManifest
ScenarioManifest.description: A published per-scenario tile manifest from a streaming job.

legacy_prefix.title: Legacy Prefix
legacy_prefix.description: Output prefix of a legacy run containing scenarios.json and <ScenarioID>.cog files.

overwrite.title: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Replace existing S3 objects with matching output keys; by default, conflicting keys fail the job.

execution_mode.title: Execution Mode
execution_mode.description: Streaming mode to rerun; use updatedstreaming to compare against an updatedlegacy run.

ParityJobRequest.title: ParityJobRequest
ParityJobRequest.description: Rerun a retained legacy run's scenarios with streaming and diff the outputs.

grid_shift_rows.description: Streaming rows offset from legacy (positive is south); realigned before counting.
grid_shift_rows.title: Grid Shift Rows

grid_shift_columns.description: Streaming columns offset from legacy (positive is east); realigned before counting.
grid_shift_columns.title: Grid Shift Columns

ScenarioParity.title: ScenarioParity
ScenarioParity.description:
Cell-level comparison of one legacy scenario COG against its streaming tiles.

Cell counts are measured after realigning a small whole-pixel grid shift, which
is reported separately and does not affect ``matches``.
